development_gate: Equal-player personal replay style TV must be strictly below v1 residual, shared and wrong identity; NLL no worse than shared and exact accuracy no more than 0.02 below shared. Stop after a failed necessary gate; do not inspect evaluation-player outcomes or run expensive generated/engine diagnostics for a rejected candidate.
history_use: Joint representation fits only 14 development players' history. The six evaluation identities fit only their embeddings with representation and shared adjustment frozen, and only after the development gate passes.
shared_condition: Equal-development-player mean embedding, with the same learned shared adjustment.
wrong_condition: Deterministic next alphabetic identity within the scored role, cyclic; each identity has the same 400 assigned history games.
overlap_rule: Reject any game shared across history and held-out sets. Quarantine development validation games also assigned to any reserved evaluation player's held-out set. Preserve all frozen game allocations and report assigned versus scored counts.
temporal_interpretation: Retrospective architecture comparison with chronological target-player histories. Pooled development histories span different calendar windows; no global as-of-date forecast claim. No held-out game may enter representation fitting.
candidate_selection: One fixed smallest candidate, no epoch selection or hyperparameter search. Replay is a necessary early rejection gate. A pass requires the separately declared generated identity and engine-quality checks before funding scale.
evidence_status: Development-only, previously inspected local cohort; cannot establish independent confirmation or model promotion.
